question: Do eight connectivity-selected right-side upstream neurons drive firing in flight-related DNg02 cells in the fixed full-v783 LIF model, and does this response require their outgoing connections?
hypothesis: The eight upstream targets, selected by positive graph weight before observing activity, increase pooled DNg02 firing relative to sham; removing all outgoing target weights reduces the DNg02 mean rate by at least 80%. This is a model-generated hypothesis, not an established biological finding.

test_designs.name: Upstream stimulation versus sham
test_designs.selection_reason: First establish propagated readout activity without directly stimulating any DNg02 neuron. Sham instantiates identical zero-rate Poisson targets and therefore the same refractory settings.
test_designs.measurement: Mean DNg02 spikes per neuron per second across all 25 predefined cells and paired seed-wise difference.
test_designs.success_criterion: Strictly positive paired difference in every seed; descriptive model result only.

test_designs.name: Outgoing-connectivity necessity control
test_designs.selection_reason: If A yields a positive response, this distinguishes connectivity-mediated output from the mere presence of the external input.
test_designs.measurement: One minus disconnected/readout mean rate per paired seed.
test_designs.success_criterion: At least 0.80 fractional reduction for every seed with nonzero driven output.

branch_rule: After A, choose B only if all three paired differences exceed zero. Otherwise use the registered direct-DNg02 calibration, preserve the null result and do not retune targets/parameters.

registered_calibration.meaning: Direct activation of all25 DNg02 cells at150Hz tests readout responsiveness only; not a network-propagation finding.

analysis: All selected cells including zeros in denominator; mean, sample standard deviation, min/max over3 fixed seeds; paired raw differences. No p-values or animal-population inference.
motor_adapter: Defined and sealed separately by body module before comparisons; neural experiment itself has no body. No result-dependent gain fitting.
limitations: Graph-selected upstream inputs are hypotheses; seven lack a verified cell-type label and none are assumed to be visual sensory inputs.
DNg02 has published flight-amplitude evidence, but this frozen assay predicts neural firing only, not takeoff or flight.
FAFB brain omits complete ventral nerve cord and wing-muscle system.
Shiu LIF model was biologically validated for feeding/grooming; these DNg02 outputs have no new independent biological validation.
Only200ms and3 simulation seeds; no general biological efficacy conclusion.
DNg02 subtypes a..g are pooled; signed-connectivity weights reflect author predictions.
Zero spontaneous activity means sham0 is expected and tests only this driven state.
Existing author model has a reset compatibility correction (remove undeclared w assignment).
Open-loop brain signal; no sensor feedback.
